title: eval: a daily MCP ask round on the open-source runner — local boot, subscription login, no cloud access
body:
epic:#34659#1 · hotlong · session_01Q4EjjMnXJdSZifpEN5i7aU

Filing gate: ④ a child of #34659, on the maintainer's words in this session's chat, 2026-11-17, verbatim: 「是否应该改成测试 mcp」 and 「而且开源项目应该就可以测试，不需要访问 cloud」. Earlier, on frequency and budget (#34632 D3): 「至少每天一次吧，应该用本地 Claude code 的套餐对吧」.

## Why

The only 问数 baseline on record tests the product's own AI inside a hosted environment, needs that environment's model billing, and has run once, on the maintainer's computer. What an open-source user gets when they connect their own AI client to a self-hosted app is measured by nothing on a schedule, though it needs no key and no cloud access to measure.

## Evidence

- `lanes/eval.md` schedules a weekly scenario-card round and a per-release product baseline (`run-ask-accuracy-cli.ts`, in the cloud repository); no round asks through MCP on a schedule.
- The scenario runner's ask mode already boots an app locally, mints per-persona keys, drives `claude -p` on a subscription login through `/api/v1/mcp`, refuses an API-billed login, and grades correct, cited and leaks (`packages/qa/scenarios/README.md`).
- This session ran 180 such ask runs against `examples/app-crm` in one container in about 35 minutes, with no API spend and no access to any hosted environment.
- The two measurements answer different questions: this one reads the server side (matching, compilation, permissions, labels) with a general client; the product baseline reads the product's own agent and stays the bar for that feature.

## Scope

- A daily round, on the eval seat's own routine: the open runner's ask mode over the cards that carry datasets (#34687), one repetition a day and five weekly, the model and effort pinned, recorded as an `eval-run`.
- The charter line in `lanes/eval.md` names it beside the product baseline, which keeps its own cadence. No card of this round reads or needs the cloud repository.
- The leak count is read as a server-side reading: a member persona asking through MCP.
- File surface: `.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/lanes/eval.md`, `.claude/skills/scenario-eval/SKILL.md`. No runner code beyond #34687.

## Done when

- Seven consecutive daily records exist, each naming the runner sha, the served model and the package source.

## Relations

- Parent: #34659. Rulings: D6 = A, D7 = A. Related: #34687 (the cards and graders it asks with), #34764 (the skills round), #34632 D3 (the product baseline's cadence, still that card's).
- Blocked-by: #34687
- Governed surface: `.claude/**`, Tier S.
- Dedup, open and closed: `daily ask round MCP eval` none found.
